fixes.explanation: Not quite, baker. God says, “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.” Forever has no finish line, so it can't end when His earthly life does. Genesis 14:18 introduces Melchizedek as king of Salem and priest of God Most High.

That's right, it's False. God says, “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.” Forever reaches past His earthly days with no limit. Melchizedek first shows up in Genesis 14:18 as king of Salem and priest of God Most High.

Fasting doesn't come up in this verse, baker. The writer says Jesus offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears, and “…He was heard because of His reverence.” Reverence means deep respect and honor toward God. So the reason given is His respect for God, not something He did first. I think that's worth sitting with.
